title: VF-010's integration tests at the fix: lib/tests/integration.rs passes with conflict-budgeted probes (closes VF-010 with the reproducer job)
description: VF-010 (verification/findings.md) was found as a flaky failure of lib/tests/integration.rs's the_tools_own_checker_agrees_with_jbmc_on_integer_proofs on Pricing#total, about 2 runs in 8: the own checker's branch probes were given wall-clock time. The fix (cleanup loop, native stream, item N1) budgets each probe in solver conflicts (Engine::probe, lib/src/bmc/mod.rs; the Sat trait's work limit, lib/src/bmc/sat.rs). This job runs the whole integration suite unchanged at the fix, JBMC cases included. Inline, here, all 64 tests passed once, and every other lib suite passed. With job 'VF-010's reproducer at the fix' it closes VF-010 when both pass.
expected: exit 0: cargo test --test integration reports 64 passed, 0 failed

resources.notes: the suite took 31 s inline after the build; a clean debug build of lib's tests peaked at 3.1 GiB with 28 jobs (cleanup.md), here 4

steps.name: integration tests
steps.run: cd lib && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo test --test integration
